data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## test-exempt
Justification: (1) no conditional logic — pure markdown cross-reference addition, (2) any test would be a change-detector test only, (3) documentation artifact with no executable behavior.

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying:
- DD1 (partial): both contracts referenced from reviewer-base.md (the reference requirement)

## What
Modify `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md` to add cross-references to both new contract documents.

## Where to Add References
In the REVIEW-DEFENSE Evaluation section (line ~296), add a "See also" note or update the section header to reference the new contracts. Add one or two lines such as:

> **Schema contracts**: The relation taxonomy (NEW_INTRODUCED, RESUSTAIN_OF, etc.) is defined in `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md`. The DefenseStore record shape is defined in `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md`.

This addition is additive — do NOT remove the existing REVIEW-DEFENSE Evaluation content (the full migration/removal is handled by the SC6 migration story 2aa7-2595).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] reviewer-base.md references review-findings-schema.md
  Verify: grep -q "review-findings-schema.md" plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md
- [ ] reviewer-base.md references review-defenses.md
  Verify: grep -q "review-defenses.md" plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Add review contract references to reviewer-base.md
